name: The same quick win again and again doesn't get the same reaction every time
case: The agent does five quick turns in a row, a minute apart, and each one passes its tests and finishes within half a minute. Boop keeps reacting, but it doesn't make the exact same face and word five times running: it varies the face, drops the word, or skips one now and then. Nothing here is big, so there's no cheer, and the mood never goes sad or grumpy.
gap: Jev answers the same line the same way, so five identical 'done, a short turn' lines get five identical reactions, and it doesn't act on 'avoid the face it made last', which would mean reading back through HISTORY. Proposed fix, in code: react takes Jev's second-best face when its first would repeat the last reaction, or HISTORY closes with Boop's last reaction again.
why: The owner's liveliness brief (2026-09-28): a repetition penalty, since the same reaction over and over is boring. plan/steering/guide.md: don't repeat what Boop just did
